title: Vibe Code Bench v1.1: Evaluating AI Models on End-to-End Web Application Development

title: Problem
问题
html:
Primary source: https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/vibe-code. Venue/status: Vals AI benchmark page, 2025. The problem is to evaluate Generated application files plus rendered behavior under browser-based checks. under a benchmark surface whose feedback is application-specific point-and-click tests and verified functional criteria. The decision boundary is evaluation and audit: it is not a training recipe, not a general proof of model reliability, and not a reusable reward unless the official source separately releases that contract.

The data object is composed of task prompt, generated code files, browser interaction result, test outcome, application-level score. The benchmark matters because it measures a concrete surface that ordinary static QA or single-function coding tests do not fully cover. For screening, read the card with the source version, scorer, split policy, and released artifacts attached to any claimed score.

一手来源：https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/vibe-code。公开状态是 Vals AI 评测页面，版本重点是 Vibe Code Bench v1.1。它要解决的问题，是评测模型能否在完整开发环境中做出可运行的网页应用，而不只是写出一段孤立代码。

数据对象包括任务说明、生成代码文件、浏览器交互结果、测试结果和应用级分数。反馈来自点击式功能测试、边界流程检查和工程师复核的准则。边界要收窄到评测和审计：它不是训练配方，也不能证明模型在所有网页开发任务上可靠。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
One-sentence contribution: Vibe Code Bench evaluates whether models can build functioning web applications in a full development environment, scored through point-and-click functional tests and review criteria. The core mechanism is to turn a realistic task substrate into an observable input-output-scoring contract rather than only reporting model impressions.

Inputs come from Web application/product-style task prompts curated by Vals AI.; outputs are Generated application files plus rendered behavior under browser-based checks.; feedback is Point-and-click tests, edge-case workflow checks, and engineer-verified criteria. It belongs under benchmark/evaluation surfaces because the central artifact is the measurement contract. Closest comparisons are other benchmark surfaces in the same domain, but this card should be read at the level of the released task object and scorer rather than as a broad model capability claim.

一句话贡献：Vibe Code Bench 把端到端网页应用开发变成可运行、可交互、可评分的评测面。核心机制是让模型产出完整应用，再用功能测试和关键用户流程检查它是否真正可用。

输入是网页应用或产品式任务说明；输出是生成的应用文件和运行行为；反馈是应用级测试与准则化评分。它应归在评测面方向，因为主要贡献是任务对象、运行环境和评分契约，而不是新的模型训练方法。

title: Method
方法
html:
The evaluation pipeline is: present the task input, run the model or agent in the specified substrate, collect the submitted artifact, execute or apply the scorer, and aggregate the result under the official leaderboard/reporting policy. The substrate is Full development environment for building web applications.

The verifier/reward component is Point-and-click tests, edge-case workflow checks, and engineer-verified criteria. Outputs are interpreted only through that contract; training or optimization use is not assumed. Reproducibility depends on pinning the task version, harness or judge version, model settings, release license, and hidden/public split policy. Artifacts to verify are paper=https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04601, project=https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/vibe-code, code=null, data=null.

评测流程是：给出网页应用任务，让模型在开发环境中生成代码，启动或渲染应用，再执行点击式测试、边界流程检查和应用级评分。底层环境是面向网页应用生成的完整开发工作流。

评分组件包括功能测试、关键用户流程和工程复核准则。输出只能在这个运行框架内解释，不能自动推出训练或奖励用途。复现时需要固定 v1.1 任务集、浏览器和渲染环境、测试脚本、模型脚手架、评分器版本和页面快照。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is the official source at https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/vibe-code. It identifies the benchmark surface, task form, and feedback contract used for reporting. Where code or data are public, the relevant artifact URLs are code=null and data=null.

The evidence boundary is intentionally narrow. Public pages can establish task intent and scoring language, but they may not expose every prompt, hidden test, judge prompt, or leaderboard filter. Any numerical comparison should therefore cite the exact page snapshot, benchmark version, and evaluator settings.

最强证据来自官方来源 https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/vibe-code。该来源能确认评测面的任务形态、对象和反馈契约。若代码或数据公开，对应工件是 code=null，data=null。

证据边界要写清楚：公开页面可以确认评测意图和评分语言，但未必公开全部 prompt、隐藏测试、评审提示词或排行榜过滤规则。任何数值比较都应注明页面快照、benchmark 版本和评估设置。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior baselines are generic benchmark leaderboards, single-answer task sets, or narrower domain tests. What changes here is the measurement surface: it asks whether a model can complete Generated application files plus rendered behavior under browser-based checks. under application-specific point-and-click tests and verified functional criteria.

The direction signal is useful because it moves evaluation toward the artifact or workflow that users actually inspect. The quality signal is strongest when the scorer, split, and artifact version are explicit. What is not new is the general idea of benchmarking models; the reusable contribution is the particular task object plus feedback contract. Reuse checks should ask: pin exact v1.1 task count and any non-public split policy before higher-level promotion; treat model scores as harness- and date-specific.

已有基线多是单函数代码题、静态代码补全或通用网页生成展示。这里的新意在于把网页应用作为最终工件，让评测直接检查功能、边界流程和交互结果。

方向信号来自更接近真实产品交付的测量对象。质量信号取决于任务数量、测试公开程度、浏览器环境和评分器是否固定。并不新的部分是“做代码评测”本身；可复用的部分是端到端网页应用任务与交互式反馈契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Limitations center on scorer coverage, release boundary, and snapshot drift. A hidden test, human vote, or judge rubric can be appropriate for the benchmark while still missing important semantic failures. Public visibility can also create contamination risk.

Scores should not be read outside the official harness. Different model scaffolds, sampling settings, browser or tool versions, prompt filters, and hidden-set policies can change outcomes. Public page verifies the benchmark surface and scoring style; full prompt/test release boundary should be checked against the current Vals release.

主要限制来自测试覆盖、视觉和功能之间的权重、浏览器版本漂移，以及公开任务带来的污染风险。即使通过点击式测试，也不能保证代码结构、安全性、可维护性或所有边界条件都正确。

分数不能脱离官方运行框架解释。不同脚手架、采样设置、浏览器版本、提示模板和隐藏测试策略都会改变结果。公开页面能确认评测面和评分方式，但完整任务、测试和发布边界仍要按当前 Vals 版本核验。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this card to decide whether Vibe Code Bench v1.1: Evaluating AI Models on End-to-End Web Application Development is the right evaluation surface for a model, agent, or system claim. It is especially useful when the claim concerns the same artifact type and feedback contract described above.

For collection and comparison, record the official source URL, benchmark version, model setup, and scorer. Avoid using the benchmark name alone as evidence; the useful unit is the pinned task/scorer/snapshot tuple.

这张卡适合用来判断 Vibe Code Bench v1.1: Evaluating AI Models on End-to-End Web Application Development 是否匹配某个模型、智能体或系统声明。只有当声明涉及同类任务工件和同类反馈契约时，它才是强证据。

用于比较时，应记录官方来源、benchmark 版本、模型设置和评分器。不要只引用 benchmark 名称；真正有意义的单位是固定后的任务、评分器和快照。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the official source first, then inspect public artifacts if available. Confirm title/version, release date, task count, scorer, split policy, license, and whether model scores are from a live leaderboard or a static report.

Watch for overclaims: benchmark success is not the same as trustworthy deployment, full correctness, or training signal quality. If an artifact is private, record that boundary explicitly rather than filling it with inference.

阅读顺序是先看官方页面，再看公开代码或数据。需要确认标题和版本、发布日期、任务数量、评分器、划分策略、许可协议，以及分数来自动态排行榜还是静态报告。

警惕过度解释：benchmark 成功不等于可部署可信、完全正确或适合作为训练信号。如果某些工件不公开，应把这个边界写明，而不是用推测补齐。
